format: single Marco's Pizza Store in leased space (approx. 1,200 to 1,600 sq ft)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Store ranges from $286,477 - $811,186, which includes $61,336 to $119,886 that must be paid to the franchisor or affiliate.

fee.quote: The Initial Franchise Fee for a single Store is $25,000 but may be discounted or waived if you qualify for and meet the obligations of one of our promotional incentives
fee.note: First responders (5+ years): $20,000. U.S. veterans: $15,000; waived for veterans with 50%+ service-connected disability. Key Management Employees: 60% of standard, $10,000 or $5,000. Waived under the Equipment Incentive Program for existing franchisees (plus up to $75,000 toward equipment). Development Agreement: $5,000 per Store, credited against the fee. In 2025 fees collected ranged from $1,000 to $25,000. Brand Launch Program of $15,500 also paid to franchisor at start of construction.

royalty.quote: Royalty 5.5% of Net Royalty Sales (subject to adjustment up to a maximum of 6.0% as described in Note 3). Paid by electronic payment (ACH debit) each Monday, 8 days after the end of each Accounting Week.

adFund.quote: Brand Development Fund Currently, 1% of Net Royalty Sales. We have the right to increase this fee by 0.5% ... The current amount of contribution required to our National Advertising Fund is 4% of Net Royalty Sales ... combined contribution to a National Advertising Fund and Regional Advertising Fund will not exceed a total of 5.5%
adFund.note: Currently 1% Brand Development Fund + 4% National Advertising Fund = 5%; Regional Advertising Fund 0.5% to 1.20% in some markets (combined geography-based cap 5.5%); BDF may rise by 0.5%. Total marketing minimum 7% of Net Royalty Sales: if no regional fund or co-op, the remaining 2% goes to Local Store Marketing.

otherRecurring.name: Software Maintenance and Support Fees
otherRecurring.amount: $430 Payable each Accounting Period (13 per year)

special: 2026 Royalty Incentive Program (3 to 5 Stores, full fees paid upfront) cuts royalty to 0% for Accounting Periods 1-6 and 2.5% for Periods 7-18. Affiliate MPD is the exclusive approved seller of new ovens and affiliate MTS supplies the only approved POS. Marketing obligations total at least 7% of Net Royalty Sales. Brand Launch Program $15,500 (up to $25,500 if performance goals are missed).
issues: Item 19 says 1,141 franchised Stores at December 28, 2025 while Item 20 Table 1 shows 1,139; Item 19 also says '582 new Stores' not open the full year, apparently a typo for 58 (its own footnote totals 58). Cover gives $61,336 to $119,886 paid to franchisor for one Store ($66,336 to $124,886 under a two-store Development Agreement). Transfer fee is a range, no single value. Technology Fee annual amount not computed (weekly fee).
